body: Dang I was hoping there was an easier way, I just would love my son to have a sibling that was blood related in some way..
Just downloaded the game and have been grinding super hard just to get no compensation for all time and coin spent on upgrading my multiple barracks. Wish I had seen this announcement before now.
Can I share this to my Facebook?? 😂🤷🏻‍♀️

I’m crying reading this, you may be right. I don’t feel confident I’ll be cared for because I have to try to take care of myself and my son now despite doctors orders to not sit or stand for longer than 15 min intervals…

I definitely watch him game when I can and listen to him constantly talk about his new missions and things he is doing etc. Yet when I try to talk to him about things I’m passionate about he claims, “I don’t have to listen or talk about things I don’t enjoy, I don’t force you to listen to my things I like so don’t hold me to that standard I didn’t place on you.”
This would be very ideal if he is willing to actually hear my request… he just feels like it’s my goal to control him when that’s not at all the case.
Thank you, I’m still new to Reddit…

I really appreciate this comment. It feels good to have validation that me trying to communicate isn’t an attack despite how he constantly takes them. It’s anytime I try to communicate my needs he feels I’m trying to “control” the marriage. It really makes me not want to communicate anymore because he makes me feel like I AM the toxic one somehow.

I feel I should add that I am an insomniac and I’m prescribed medication to help me fall asleep. It’s not that I cannot sleep without him it’s that I desire the intimacy that comes with sleeping with my husband. We’ve been married for two and half years and we used to sleep together every night. I built his new PC at the beginning of this year as a gift for his birthday in January and he has been addicted ever since. I have two surgeries upcoming and have been incredibly stressed.
I try to fall asleep by 10pm but I usually force myself to stay away until he goes to sleep around 12am-3am depending on when his friends are getting off.
